notes: Independent reconstruction of the SRC-0002 p.24 homology induction at k=16. From (6.1) and BFP vanishing, finite pure-weight base pairs are those with n in {0,1} and 2g<=16, or n>=2 and n<=18-2g (stable). Discharge: g=0 tautological; g=1 even cohomology tautological; g=2 by Cor 2.7; g=3..7 with n<=c(g) by Table 1 + Prop 4.5/Lemma 4.3 (CKgP => pure-weight algebraic => pure Hodge-Tate). Remaining undischarged: (3,12) since c(3)=11; (5,8) since c(5)=7; (6,6) since c(6)=5; (7,4) since c(7)=3 (Thm 1.10); (8,0),(8,1),(8,2) with no CKgP in sources (SRC-0005 A^*=R^* for open M_8 does not give CKgP). Exact match to RED-0001 residual list. Distinctions: pure HT is weaker than algebraic generation and than tautological Chow; CKgP is the load-bearing pure-weight tool. Global pure Tate in degree 16 remains open (SRC-0001); that is expected and not a disagreement.
